fields.Name: IT166 - Predictive Shadow Scoring and Drift
fields.Description: Exercises Predictive Studio's live challenger and PSI drift evaluation end-to-end (deterministic, no sidecar). PSD1: a bound 'ML Model' Record Process whose ChallengerConfiguration names a challenger is scored through ScoringService; its champion and challenger predictions are Source='Model' Feature Values, each role under its own MJ: ML Scoring Runs row, with no Source='Pipeline' row. PSD2: seeds baseline and drifted evaluation MJ: Feature Values rows and invokes PredictiveStudioEvaluateDriftAction through ActionEngineServer, verifying both MinSampleSize=100 InsufficientData gating and MinSampleSize=10 OverallSeverity='Critical' alert emission.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The champion's and the challenger's rows of a bound process are Source='Model' rows of two scoring runs (one per role) and no Pipeline row is written; PredictiveStudioEvaluateDriftAction loads windows from MJ: Feature Values, enforces MinSampleSize=100 InsufficientData gating, detects Critical PSI drift at MinSampleSize=10, and emits an alert record.
